subject: Alignment call: temporary invoice-only onboarding for Argyle Systems
messages:
From: Elena Varga <elena@argylesys.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Peter Lowe <peter.lowe@argylesys.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: pilot onboarding + PO question

Hi Sean —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to kick off the 30‑day pilot but our procurement team is asking whether Redwood can accept single invoices for the trial instead of issuing a PO for the pilot amount (~$6k).

Argyle is a small dev tools shop; our AP workflow is set up for invoice routing only for pilots under $10k. If you require a PO we can request one internally but it will add ~2 weeks.

Attached: Argyle_W‑9.pdf (W‑9) — I’ve also included contact for our finance lead (Peter).

Can we do a temporary invoice‑only onboarding with minimal evidence (W‑9 + bank ACH confirmation) and sign the MSA later? What does Redwood need to accept that path?

Best,
Elena Varga
Head of Partnerships, Argyle Systems
elena@argylesys.com
Phone: +1 415‑555‑0123

From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Varga <elena@argylesys.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: pilot onboarding + PO question

Elena — thanks for the context and the W‑9. Appreciate the clear ask. Short answer: we can sometimes onboard on an invoice‑only path for small pilots, but we need to satisfy Finance and Legal on a few items first.

To move quickly I need to confirm the following:
- Evidence: W‑9 (you provided) + ACH confirmation or remittance contact.
- Risk: no POs increases payment ambiguity. For pilots under $10k we usually use a temporary supplier record with limited invoicing and a 60‑day payment SLA.
- Contracting: we can accept a signed purchase acknowledgement + your standard terms, but Legal prefers an MSA on file. If you can’t sign an MSA now, we can add a short playbook clause that the pilot is subject to Redwood’s "trial supplier" terms.

Priyom / Naomi — can you confirm what evidence Finance would accept to create a temp supplier and the SLA we should offer? Also need to know if sales can approve up to $10k invoice‑only pilots without additional escalations.

Next steps for Argyle: Elena, please send ACH proof or bank letter and the name/email for AP. If you can share a vendor portal link or online payment page that helps.

Sean Gallagher
Sales Director — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: pilot onboarding + PO question

On Sun, Sep 13, 2026 at 11:03 AM sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Priyom / Naomi — can you confirm what evidence Finance would accept to create a temp supplier and the SLA we should offer?

Quick reply with Finance checks:
- Minimum evidence for a temporary supplier: W‑9 + one of (ACH confirmation, bank letter, recent invoice from vendor showing bank details).
- Approval limits: Sales can approve up to $7.5k for a trial on invoice‑only. Anything above that requires finance manager signoff.
- SLA: we can offer 60‑day net for pilots, but note we require prepayment options for non‑US entities or higher‑risk vendors.
- Controls: create supplier flag "pilot_invoice_only" that limits total invoiced amount and prevents multi‑year commitments.

Suggested language Sean can send to Elena:
"We can onboard Argyle Systems on an invoice‑only basis for this 30‑day pilot up to $7.5k contingent on (1) W‑9 + ACH or bank confirmation, (2) one‑page purchase acknowledgement signed by Argyle, and (3) acceptance of Redwood’s trial supplier terms (no long‑term commitments)."

I’ll loop Marissa (Ops) if we need an exception to hit $10k.

—Priyom
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Varga <elena@argylesys.com>
Cc: Peter Lowe <peter.lowe@argylesys.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: pilot onboarding + PO question

Elena — good news, we can move forward on a temporary invoice‑only path with the following caveats:

1) Limit: we can cover the 30‑day pilot up to $7.5k on invoice‑only without further escalation. If the pilot invoices exceed that, we’ll need a PO or an approval from Procurement.
2) Evidence required: W‑9 (received) + ACH confirmation or bank letter. Please send a scanned bank confirmation or a voided check.
3) Paperwork: please sign the attached one‑page purchase acknowledgement (I’ve attached MSA‑draft placeholder). We will onboard you as a "pilot_invoice_only" supplier and tag the account to prevent multi‑year auto‑renewals.
4) Payment terms: Net 60 for this pilot, standard payment processing applies.

If that works, Elena, please reply with the ACH confirmation and have Peter (finance) sign the acknowledgement. I’ll ask Procurement to provision the temporary supplier record and share the vendor ID.

Thanks — excited to get Argyle started.

Sean Gallagher
Sales Director — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
